en: Sepia-toned vintage street scene showing a bustling commercial avenue lined with multi‑story shops and hanging signboards. People in early 20th‑century dress walk along the street. Large signs read "SIMON ARZT", "THE TOURIST STORES" and others. At the bottom center in cursive is a caption identifying the location as Port‑Said, Prince Farouk Street, and there is a small printed number at the lower left.
